title: Look... Haunted House Training Night
trend: TikTok 'Look…' two-person reaction format (one person says 'look…' and names a scary thing, the other panics, then it flips to a more personal fear; SocialBee's October 2026 US TikTok trends list) — acted out on training night at a homemade haunted house ten days before Halloween
length_reason: Quick two-person reaction format whose originals are single short clips, so it stays at the low end (3:00), which also keeps it inside Instagram's Reels limit.
youtube_title: Look... he's not scared of monsters, just everything else 👻
description:
Opening night is Friday and the new scare guy fears nothing in the haunted house. Voicemails, group projects and quick questions are a different story.

#looktrend #look #hauntedhouse #halloween #spookyseason #comedy #animation #funny
tiktok_caption: look… a voicemail from your landlord 👻 haunted house training night #looktrend #hauntedhouse #halloween #fyp

lines.text: Look... a werewolf.
Aw. He's got a little sweater on.
Look... a voicemail from your landlord.
No! Don't play it! Delete it! Delete my whole phone!
Opening night is Friday, Benji. You're supposed to be the scariest thing in here.
And I will be. I'm just not scared of scary things.
I'm scared of real things. Like phone calls. And people who say quick question.
Quick question.
Ah! Who said that?
The fog machine. I've been on this porch since August. Nobody asks how I'm doing.
I'm always nervous. That's why this porch looks so good.
Fine. Training. I say look, you react. Like the videos.
Got it. Hit me.
Look... a zombie hand coming out of the ground.
High five, buddy. Love the effort.
Look... a group project. Due tomorrow. Your partners are both named Chad.
Two Chads? No! I'll do it alone! I'll do the whole thing alone!
Too much fog. Too much fog. Sorry.
We can't scare guests with group projects, Benji.
You could. Put a sign on the door. Please introduce yourself to the group.
My turn. Look... a smoke detector.
Where? Don't tell it about me! We have history!
Look... someone plugging you in right next to the microwave.
The lights go out and everyone looks at me! It was the microwave once!
Okay. Let's test the animatronic. The old guy on the stairs.
I paid extra for the blinking.
You did not pay for anything, madam.
He talks too? That was not in the warranty.
Look... a chain rattling up in the attic.
That is my chain. I keep it up there. That is where I keep my things.
Look... a door that slowly opens all by itself.
I did that. I was being polite.
Look... a guy with a flashlight and a podcast saying, did you hear that?
No. Not the podcast men. They ask me questions in the dark and never wait for the answer.
Okay, wait. Is the animatronic a real ghost?
I am Mortimer. I have lived in this house since eighteen ninety four.
And Benjamin. You have not called.
Grandpa Mort? Hi! You look great. Very see-through.
Grandpa?
Great great grandpa. I grew up in this house. He tucked me in. Through the wall.
That's why nothing here scares me. The werewolf is the neighbor's dog in my old sweater.
You did not tell me any of this when I rented it.
His grandmother said it came with an old man on the stairs.
I thought she meant a decoration!
She did. I decorate.
Grandpa. Look... the family group chat.
Not the group chat. Two hundred messages, all soup. I cannot eat soup.
Okay. Can we open on Friday or not?
Look... eight hundred people. On opening night.
Good. That's great. That's the dream.
Look... all eight hundred want to speak to the manager.
No! Close the house! I'm the werewolf now!
Benjamin. Call your grandmother.
